title: Build a production-ready SaaS landing page for a fictional AI startup called "Lu
description:
Build a production-ready SaaS landing page for a fictional AI startup called "Lumina AI".

Requirements:
- Use HTML, CSS, and JavaScript only.
- Create separate index.html, styles.css, and script.js files.
- Design a premium, modern interface with polished typography, subtle animations, and excellent visual hierarchy.
- Include a hero section, features, pricing, testimonials, FAQ, contact form, and footer.
- Implement dark/light mode with smooth transitions.
- Make the site fully responsive across desktop, tablet, and mobile.
- Ensure accessibility using semantic HTML, keyboard navigation, ARIA labels, and proper contrast.
- Optimize performance by minimizing unnecessary JavaScript, lazy-loading where appropriate, and using efficient CSS.
- Verify that every button, link, animation, and form behaves correctly.
- Produce clean, maintainable, production-quality code with clear organization.

Expected behavior:
- Create a complete execution plan before coding.
- Execute each stage sequentially.
- Run verification after every major stage.
- Automatically repair any detected issues before continuing.
- Use project memory to avoid duplicate work.
- Create timeline checkpoints throughout execution.
- Generate diagnostics for every stage.
- Complete only after the reviewer approves the final result and all verification checks pass.

logs.action: Executing task: Initialize project structure and create base files

metadata.taskTitle: Initialize project structure and create base files
metadata.goal: Set up the project directory with the required files (index.html, styles.css, script.js) and a basic HTML5 boilerplate to start development.
metadata.expectedOutput: Project folder containing index.html, styles.css, and script.js files; index.html includes a minimal HTML5 doctype, head with meta charset/viewport, and links to styles.css and script.js.

logs.action: Task completed: Initialize project structure and create base files
Executing task: Define CSS custom properties, base reset, and typography

metadata.taskTitle: Define CSS custom properties, base reset, and typography
metadata.goal: Establish a consistent design system using CSS variables for colors, spacing, fonts, and apply a modern reset plus base typography for readability.
metadata.expectedOutput: styles.css includes :root with color variables (light and dark palettes), spacing scale, font families, a CSS reset (box-sizing, margin, etc.), and base body styles.

logs.action: Task completed: Define CSS custom properties, base reset, and typography
Executing task: Implement hero section HTML and styling

metadata.taskTitle: Implement hero section HTML and styling
metadata.goal: Create the hero section with headline, subheadline, call-to-action buttons, and a background image, ensuring visual hierarchy and initial styling.
metadata.expectedOutput: index.html contains a <section id="hero"> with appropriate heading, paragraph, and two buttons; styles.css provides layout (flex/grid), typography sizing, spacing, and responsive image handling.

logs.action: Task completed: Implement hero section HTML and styling
Executing task: Add dark/light mode toggle functionality

metadata.goal: Implement a theme switcher that toggles between light and dark modes with smooth transitions and persists user preference via localStorage.
metadata.expectedOutput: index.html includes a toggle button (e.g., in header) with aria-label; script.js contains logic to read/write theme preference, add/remove a 'dark' class on <html>, and CSS uses the .dark selector to override variables; transition on background and color properties.

logs.action: Task completed: Add dark/light mode toggle functionality
Executing task: Build features section with icons and descriptions

metadata.taskTitle: Build features section with icons and descriptions
metadata.goal: Create a section showcasing Lumina AI's key features, each with an icon, title, and description, using a responsive grid layout.
metadata.expectedOutput: index.html contains <section id="features"> with a container and multiple <article> feature cards; styles.css provides grid layout (auto-fit/minmax), card styling, hover effects, and icon styling (using inline SVG or font).
